name: Halt and Catch Fire
description: During the rise of the PC era in the early 1980s, an unlikely trio - a visionary, an engineer and a prodigy - take personal and professional risks in the race to build a computer that will change the world as they know it.

videos.title: I/O
videos.overview: The Texan company Cardiff Electronics gets a new employee from New York. He's apparently working for IBM, but after the he gets the new job it gets clear that he has a hidden agenda, and is not exactly what he claims to be.

videos.title: FUD
videos.overview: After surviving a visit from IBM, Joe's team must overcome internal differences and begin the technical feat of building the new machine.

videos.title: High Plains Hardware
videos.overview: Gordon and Cameron struggle to make Joe's vision a reality; Joe and Bosworth seek the funds to make the new machine.

videos.title: Close to the Metal
videos.overview: As Cameron nears completion of the BIOS, a crisis threatens the project's future and requires all hands on deck to save the machine.

videos.title: Adventure
videos.overview: Cameron bristles under a new manager as Joe and Gordon attempt to procure a key piece of new technology for the computer.

videos.title: Landfall
videos.overview: A breakthrough by Cameron places her at odds with Gordon, leaving Joe to make a tough decision. Meanwhile, Hurricane Alicia spurs some personal revelations.

videos.title: Giant
videos.overview: A visitor from Joe's past threatens his newfound connection with Cameron. Meanwhile, with Donna out of town, the toll of Gordon's work catches up with him.

videos.title: The 214s
videos.overview: Scandal hits Cardiff Electric as the team finalizes preparations for COMDEX. Meanwhile, Bosworth makes a sacrifice for the good of the PC program.

videos.title: Up Helly Aa
videos.overview: Unforeseen opponents and new complications threaten to derail the Cardiff Electric team's work at COMDEX.
Gordon and Joe prepare to transport the Giant.  A suspicious defect causes a rift in the partnership.

videos.title: SETI
videos.overview: Cameron and Donna's gaming company, Mutiny, reaches a critical stage. Joe and Gordon are reunited.

videos.title: New Coke
videos.overview: Joe begins a new job after meeting Sara's father. Gordon grapples with his newfound freedom.

videos.title: The Way In
videos.overview: John attempts to reconnect with his old life. Gordon and Donna get a surprising invitation.

videos.title: Play with Friends
videos.overview: Joe and Gordon work together to bring about Joe's vision. There is tension between Cameron and Donna.

videos.title: Extract and Defend
videos.overview: Cameron and Joe clash leaving Cameron in a tailspin. Gordon attempts to deal with some difficult news.

videos.title: 10Broad36
videos.overview: Gordon is back in California, hoping to reconnect with his brother. Joe uses the leverage that he has.

videos.title: Working for the Clampdown
videos.overview: Gordon and Donna are keeping secrets from one another. Gordon sets up a new venture.

videos.title: Limbo
videos.overview: Cameron and Tom attempt to come to terms at Mutiny's user picnic. Gordon looks for some answers.

videos.title: Kali
videos.overview: Shocked by a rival's launch, Mutiny takes measures to make sure of survival.

videos.title: Heaven Is a Place
videos.overview: After the Clark family descends into crisis, Gordon  attempts to help Joe.

videos.title: Valley of the Heart's Delight
videos.overview: Donna and Cameron explore their options to expand beyond chat.  Meanwhile, Gordon settles in at Mutiny and Joe launches his latest product.

videos.title: One Way or Another
videos.overview: While Cameron and Donna struggle to find venture capital, Joe hires a key coder, leaving the rest of the team at a loss.

videos.title: Flipping the Switch
videos.overview: Tensions rise at the office as Gordon and Donna's personal life spills into work. Meanwhile, Joe meets with the MacMillan board.

videos.title: Rules of Honorable Play
videos.overview: A game of laser tag teaches Gordon the importance of teamwork; Donna and Cameron disagree on their acquisition.

videos.title: Yerba Buena
videos.overview: Donna and Gordon decide to treat themselves to a vacation at home instead of camping. Bos and Cameron return to Texas. Ryan and Joe have a revelation.

videos.title: And She Was
videos.overview: Tensions rise over an offer to buy Mutiny. Donna has a weekend alone, while Gordon and Cam bond over video games. Joe has a standoff with the board.

videos.title: The Threshold
videos.overview: Joe and Ryan deal with the consequences of Joe's decision. Cameron and Donna fight over the future, while Gordon has a crisis of conscience.

videos.title: You Are Not Safe
videos.overview: Donna, Bos and Diane go on the road to build support for Mutiny, while everyone else anxiously awaits the big day. Joe asks Cam for a favor.

videos.title: NIM
videos.overview: Donna tries to bring everyone together at Comdex with her vision of the internet's future and Gordon faces a strong-willed Joanie.

videos.title: NeXT
videos.overview: While Donna's vision inspires a spirited discussion about the next big thing and how to achieve it, the end result may not make everyone happy.

videos.title: So It Goes
videos.overview: Gordon enjoys success while Joe works to keep their web project afloat. Cameron extends a business trip. Donna launches a new venture.

videos.title: Signal to Noise
videos.overview: Joe and Cameron talk on the phone. Donna promotes her assistant. Gordon's business buckles under pressure from a larger competitor.

videos.title: Miscellaneous
videos.overview: Cameron promotes her game at an industry conference. Donna squares off against old rivals. Gordon struggles to support Joe's newest idea.

videos.title: Tonya and Nancy
videos.overview: Cameron buys a plot of land to re-center. Joe and Gordon hire a team of websurfers to map the web. Donna focuses her team on the mission ahead.

videos.title: Nowhere Man
videos.overview: Donna struggles with suspicion. Bosworth hits a breaking point. Joe confesses to Gordon while Cameron faces past mistakes.

videos.title: A Connection Is Made
videos.overview: Donna makes a play for a heavy hitter. Gordon confronts his daughter about an issue at school. Cameron finds a new fan. Joe sees a new side of Haley.

videos.title: Who Needs a Guy
videos.overview: Joe and Gordon discuss Comet's future; Donna takes a vacation. A new collaborator challenges Cameron. Bos and Diane make a life-altering choice.

videos.title: Goodwill
videos.overview: Cameron helps Donna pack up. Bos makes his famous chili. Joe helps Haley recover a memorable keep sake. Gordon and Donna fight.

videos.title: Search
videos.overview: Donna faces a professional crossroads. Joanie takes a trip. Joe unveils Comet's new look. Cameron asks a favor from a one-time collaborator.

videos.title: Ten of Swords
videos.overview: In the series finale, Donna celebrates a milestone with her closest allies. Cameron contemplates saying goodbye as Joe confronts an uncertain future.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 2 wins & 14 nominations total
